'''Otu Del''' was an individual who owned [[Otu Del's Custom Pods and Swoops]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], a major port city on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] world [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
